description: Random chaos injection to prevent stagnation and discover unexpected patterns

random_switch.description: 10% chance of completely random personality switch
random_switch.reasoning: Prevents getting stuck in patterns, discovers novel combinations

unexpected_combinations.description: Occasionally force unusual persona for task type
examples: Experimenter doing security audit (finds weird edge cases)
Auditor doing rapid prototyping (creates secure-by-default prototypes)

stagnation_detection.description: Detect when system is in repetitive patterns

chaos_amplification.description: Increase chaos when patterns are detected

discovery_tracking.description: Track when chaos leads to valuable discoveries
discovery_tracking.learning: Adjust chaos probability based on discovery rate

notes: Chaos is not randomness for its own sake
It's deliberate injection of unpredictability to discover emergent patterns
Successful chaos combinations should be learned from
Failed chaos should inform future probability adjustments
